summary_md:
# Operation rädda börsen

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-11-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts react to Friday's US tech sell-off, when Nasdaq fell about 5% and Nvidia 14%, but argue it is a correction tied to doubts about AI investment returns rather than an existential crash. Mikael Olsson warns that a strong main owner can become a liability, citing Bioinvent, Orexo, Fagerhult/Latour and Nvidia's ousted CEO. Robert Andersson criticises index concentration risk. Johan Wendel describes an 'Operation rädda börsen' built on Jensen Huang returning as CEO, data-centre expansion continuing and a softer Fed, and warns of a US recession if it fails.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 ABB — ABB | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

SEK 27bn acquisition of a German fan maker; full speed on restructuring after the CEO succession.

#### Reasoning

Hosts view the offensive M&A in a turbulent market as positive. The deal shows ABB's plan and CEO succession are on track despite the cancelled SoftBank Robotics sale. They caution that each individual deal and spin-off still has to prove itself. No explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the acquired German business fails to improve margins
- if the restructuring or spin-offs stall

> *"Det antyder att det är full fart fortfarande på ABB."*

---

### ⛔ ORX — Orexo | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Shares fell 90%+ after main owner Novo Holdings stayed out of the refinancing.

#### Reasoning

A loss-making research company whose main owner declined to back the capital raise. That sends a strong negative signal to other investors and pushes refinancing towards underwriters, who press the price down. Cited as a cautionary example rather than an explicit recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a new committed anchor investor backs financing
- if the company reaches profitability

> *"När man skulle ta in pengar och de säger att de inte är med så är det en jättestark signal till alla andra."*

---

### ⛔ BINV — Bioinvent | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Shares fell 90%+ after main owners did not back the refinancing.

#### Reasoning

Same pattern as Orexo: an unprofitable research company whose main owners (Red Mile Group, Van Herk) did not take part in the capital raise. The former premium for strong owners has vanished and there are few willing investors. Cautionary example, not an explicit call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the main owners re-commit capital
- if financing is secured on reasonable terms

> *"Nu har de fått se sina aktiekurser krascha 90 % plus på kort tid."*

---

### 🟠 FAG — Fagerhult | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Share price has performed very poorly; Latour may have been too lenient as main owner.

#### Reasoning

Mikael's theory is that Latour's unconditional support removed discipline. A tougher owner might have stopped acquisitions and capitalised on megatrends. He still thinks Latour will take care of Fagerhult, which is why this is watch, not avoid.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Latour does not tighten governance
- if operational performance keeps deteriorating

> *"Det har blivit ett problem för Fagerhult."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fell 14%. A comeback by Jensen Huang, backed by Trump and Bessent, is part of the 'rescue the market' scenario.

#### Reasoning

Johan sees signs of a coordinated effort to lift the market: Huang's possible return, continued data-centre buildout and a softer Fed. He explicitly does not endorse it. Key-person risk has become painfully clear. If the rescue fails, a US recession is a risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Huang does not return
- if AI capex fails to produce earnings growth
- if the Fed hikes and a US recession follows

> *"Jensen Wang ska göra comeback som VD för Nvidia."*

---
